parameters.content:
## WF3 — RAG Matching
Supabase Postgres lead context → Gemini embedding (768 dimensions) → Qdrant `olivesoft_knowledge` filtered by CV, project, stack and `supabase_storage` source → evidence-linked matches.

Configure Postgres, Gemini header `x-goog-api-key`, Qdrant header `api-key`, and n8n `OLIVESOFT_QDRANT_URL`. Only privately stored source bucket/path metadata is returned; use an authenticated signed URL for review.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ content: { parts: [{ text: $json.queries.join('\n') }] }, embedContentConfig: { outputDimensionality: 768, taskType: 'RETRIEVAL_QUERY' } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ query: $('Gemini Query Embedding').first().json.embedding.values, filter: { must: [{ key: 'asset_type', match: { value: 'cv' } }, { key: 'source', match: { value: 'supabase_storage' } }] }, limit: 5, with_payload: true }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ query: $('Gemini Query Embedding').first().json.embedding.values, filter: { must: [{ key: 'asset_type', match: { value: 'project' } }, { key: 'source', match: { value: 'supabase_storage' } }] }, limit: 5, with_payload: true }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ query: $('Gemini Query Embedding').first().json.embedding.values, filter: { must: [{ key: 'asset_type', match: { value: 'stack' } }, { key: 'source', match: { value: 'supabase_storage' } }] }, limit: 5, with_payload: true }) }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO matches (lead_id, asset_type, asset_ref, document_id, title, evidence, score)
SELECT (m->>'lead_id')::uuid, m->>'asset_type', m->>'asset_ref',
       COALESCE(m->'payload'->>'document_id',m->>'asset_ref'),
       COALESCE(m->'payload'->>'title',m->>'asset_ref'),
       COALESCE(m->'payload','{}'::jsonb), COALESCE((m->>'score')::numeric,0)
FROM jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb->'matches') AS m RETURNING id, lead_id;
UPDATE leads SET status = 'matched', updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::uuid RETURNING id, status;
UPDATE leads SET status='failed', updated_at=now() WHERE id=NULLIF($1::jsonb->>'lead_id','')::uuid RETURNING id,status;
